articles.title: llm-harness-lite added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article outlines a new lightweight software project, positioned as a local-first, vendor-neutral, and cost-aware alternative to frameworks like LangChain. Featuring a compact ~1k LOC core, it prioritizes readability and simplicity. Its architecture incorporates an LLM factory, agent loop, and tool registry, with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) integrated as a key capability, offering an efficient approach to AI development.
